subject: DPIA: scope mapping, stakeholder playbook & delivery deadlines
messages:
From: Lucia Romero <lucia@valencemed.com>
To: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
Cc: dpia-team@valencemed.com
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 09:17:00 +0000
Subject: DPIA request & questionnaire — scope clarification

Hi Hiro,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Valence is starting our DPIA (we need to include Redwood as a subprocessors) and our privacy team sent a short template for scoping and timelines. Two quick asks: 1) can you confirm which processing locations Redwood will use for our EU workloads (customer data residency), and 2) we need a stakeholder playbook that maps Valence owners to Redwood contacts and expected evidence delivery windows.

The team would like a short initial reply by end of week so we can decide whether to proceed with the full template.

Appreciate it,
Lucia
Privacy Program Manager
Valence Medical

Attachment: Valence_DPIA_Template_v0.9.docx (referenced)

From: hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
To: Lucia Romero <lucia@valencemed.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Feb 2027 13:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: DPIA request & questionnaire — scope clarification

Hi Lucia — thanks for the note and the template. Looping in Laura (Security & Compliance) and Monica (Technical Account Lead) to scope. High level answers now so you can proceed: 

- Processing locations: For Valence EU workloads we will prioritize EU-region hosts (Frankfurt and Dublin) by default; data at rest is stored in those regions and we offer SCCs and region routing in the contract.
- Playbook: we can produce a concise stakeholder playbook that lists point people, evidence owners, and a 3-step delivery timeline (initial mapping, evidence bundle, final review).

Proposed near-term timeline:
1) Feb 3 — deliver draft stakeholder playbook + list of requested evidence
2) Feb 10 — provide evidence bundle (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, SCCs mapping)
3) Feb 17 — final clarifications and sign-off notes

If that works, Laura will own the evidence list and Monica will coordinate technical artifacts.

Best,
Hiro
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

Hi Lucia,

Thanks — Laura here from Redwood Security. Per Hiro's timeline, attached is a draft stakeholder playbook and a starter evidence checklist. Key notes:

- Data flows: redwood processes customer prompt/response text and limited metadata (request timestamps, routing ids) under customer-controlled keys. We do not retain customer content beyond configured retention; retention is configurable in Dedicated/Private deployments.
- SCCs & legal: we will provide our SCCs mapping in a separate spreadsheet (attached) and confirm the effective places of processing.
- Evidence owners: Laura (security) — SOC 2 summary, security architecture; Monica (tech) — DFD, logging and retention configs; Hiro — contract & SCCs routing.

Ask from Valence: please confirm which internal Valence owners (privacy, legal, infra) should be included in review calls and whether you prefer a single consolidated bundle vs incremental delivery.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPIA_Playbook_v1.pdf, SCCs_Mapping_Valence.xlsx

- Include our Privacy lead (Nathan Cole <nathan.cole@valencemed.com>) and Head of Infra (Priya Desai <priya@valencemed.com>) on the review call.

Hi all — Monica here and thanks for the quick replies. Confirming the Feb 7 09:00 GMT sync; invite sent.

Answer to the logging question (concise):
- Request logs: timestamp, request_id, model_version, region_routing_tag, and a hashed session identifier.
- Network telemetry: source IP is captured for routing and security; it is not stored beyond 30 days for hosted customers by default (configurable).
- User-agent is recorded in ephemeral logs for troubleshooting and retained for 7 days.

Deliverables we will upload to the shared drive by Feb 3 (as a draft):
- Redwood_DPIA_Playbook_v1.pdf (stakeholder map + delivery windows)
- SCCs_Mapping_Valence.xlsx (SCC clause mapping to our controls)

We will follow up with the evidence bundle on Feb 10 (SOC 2 summary, encrypted DFD, retention configuration screenshots).

If you need anything earlier, reply to this thread.

Best,
Monica Patel
Technical Account Lead | Redwood Inference
